About.title: About me
About.p1: Senior Full-Stack & AI Architect based in South Korea, living and building in the Korean tech ecosystem since 2023. I specialize in taking mission-critical platforms and production AI from zero to scale as an autonomous end-to-end builder — fluent in English, Korean, and Russian.
About.p2: Architected the core backend for Blue Networks' E-Chae-Um EV CSMS across 1,600+ chargers in 500+ locations using Java 17, Spring Boot, MyBatis, and sharded databases — delivering OCPP 1.6J/2.0.1 bidirectional WebSocket telemetry, bulk OTA firmware distribution, and national KECO inter-operator roaming data (로밍 데이터) synchronization with Smartro PG settlements.
About.p3: Engineered the AI-powered EV Power Demand Forecasting & Contract Optimization Platform: combining an 8-model ensemble (PyTorch LSTM, XGBoost, and GEV/GPD Extreme Value Theory) to forecast peak power loads in P50/P90 probabilistic quantiles, significantly reducing KEPCO electricity tariffs and peak surcharge penalties.
About.p4: Today, I specialize in shipping modern AI SaaS platforms, streaming LLM agents (Claude, OpenAI, Gemini), multilingual STT/TTS, and reactive Next.js 15 / TypeScript full-stack architectures containerized across Docker, Linux, AWS, and GCP.

ProjectDetail.role: Senior AI & Full-Stack Architect — EV CSMS, Batch & AI Energy Forecasting
ProjectDetail.title: Blue Networks: E-Chae-Um & AI Power Demand Forecasting Platform
ProjectDetail.summary: Enterprise EV Charging Station Management System (CSMS) managing 1,600+ chargers across Korea and an 8-model AI ensemble platform (PyTorch LSTM, XGBoost, EVT) delivering probabilistic P50/P90 power demand forecasts to optimize KEPCO contracted capacity and eliminate peak surcharge penalties.
ProjectDetail.problemText: Delivering sub-second bidirectional telemetry across 1,600+ fast and slow EV chargers in 500+ locations in Korea, executing safe bulk OTA firmware updates without network saturation, synchronizing inter-CPO roaming data with the Ministry of Environment (KECO), and preventing 1.5x peak power penalty surcharges from KEPCO.
ProjectDetail.solutionText: Engineered high-concurrency OCPP 1.6-J / 2.0.1 bidirectional WebSocket gateways via BNCPOs (Java 17, Spring Boot, MyBatis), automated KECO national roaming and Smartro PG payment reconciliation via BNCPOsBatch, operator monitoring via BNCPOsWebApp, and an 8-model AI ensemble power demand forecasting platform (power-demand-platform-v2) using PyTorch LSTM, XGBoost, and Extreme Value Theory (EVT GEV/GPD).
ProjectDetail.overviewP1: Blue Networks (kblue.co.kr) is Korea's premier EV charging infrastructure and IoT solution provider, operating over 1,600 charging stations under the E-Chae-Um brand nationwide. As Senior Full-Stack & AI Architect, I designed, implemented, and scaled 4 core production sub-systems: BNCPOs, BNCPOsBatch, BNCPOsWebApp, and power-demand-platform-v2.
ProjectDetail.overviewP2: 1. BNCPOs (Core CSMS & Admin Control Server): Built with Java 17, Spring Boot, and MyBatis. Delivers high-throughput bidirectional WebSocket telemetry on OCPP 1.6J and OCPP 2.0.1 protocols. Enables remote station control (RemoteStart, RemoteStop, Reset, UnlockConnector, Diagnostics), modem diagnostics, and time-staggered bulk OTA firmware rollouts to prevent network congestion. Dashboard performance was dramatically enhanced via Redis clustering and 23:50 daily aggregations.
ProjectDetail.overviewP3: 2. BNCPOsBatch & BNCPOsWebApp: BNCPOsBatch manages automated inter-operator roaming data pipelines with the Korea Environment Corporation (KECO), reconciles Smartro PG payment transactions, and runs automated daily billing settlements. BNCPOsWebApp serves as the real-time operational dashboard for monitoring charging sessions, charger health, and analytics.
ProjectDetail.overviewP4: 3. power-demand-platform-v2 (AI Power Demand Forecasting & KEPCO Cost Optimizer): An AI-driven forecasting platform engineered with FastAPI (Python), PyTorch, XGBoost, and SvelteKit. Combines an 8-model ensemble (PyTorch LSTM, XGBoost, and Extreme Value Theory GEV/GPD) to forecast daily median expected demand (P50) and top-10% critical peak load (P90) with an 80% confidence band. Generates optimal KEPCO contracted power recommendations, eliminating 1.5x peak surcharge penalties.
capabilities: Bidirectional WebSocket live telemetry across 1,600+ chargers via OCPP 1.6-J & 2.0.1 protocols
Network-safe staggered OTA bulk firmware distribution (Bulk Firmware Update)
National KECO inter-operator roaming data synchronization
Smartro PG payment reconciliation and automated billing batch pipelines
8-model AI ensemble (PyTorch LSTM + XGBoost + EVT GEV/GPD) for power demand forecasting
P50 and P90 quantile probability modeling with KEPCO contract capacity optimization
High-throughput Redis caching, sharded MySQL/PostgreSQL, and resilient microservice architecture
ProjectDetail.videoDescription: Real-world operational preview of E-Chae-Um EV chargers and live telemetry.

ViserPetDetail.role: Full-Stack Engineer & Architect — E-Commerce, GraphQL & Real-Time Platform
ViserPetDetail.title: ViserPet: Pet E-Commerce & Community Platform
ViserPetDetail.summary: Full-stack pet e-commerce and social platform built with Next.js App Router, Apollo Client, GraphQL, and NestJS + MongoDB (Mongoose). Features real-time WebSocket notifications & messaging, dynamic URL-synchronized multi-parameter filtering, and dedicated portals for sellers and administrators.
ViserPetDetail.problemText: Pet owners and vendors needed a unified platform for shopping, order tracking, real-time live chat inquiries, and community discussions. A key challenge was delivering instant multi-parameter product discovery with shareable URL query states without performance bottlenecks.
ViserPetDetail.solutionText: Engineered a Next.js (App Router) frontend with TypeScript and SCSS/MUI, backed by a NestJS monorepo, Apollo GraphQL API, WebSocket gateways, and MongoDB (Mongoose). Implemented strict Role-Based Access Control (User, Seller, Admin) and JWT authentication.
ViserPetDetail.overviewP1: ViserPet delivers a complete end-to-end e-commerce experience tailored for the pet market, featuring comprehensive product listings, dynamic wishlist/cart flows, vendor stores, and community discussion boards.
ViserPetDetail.overviewP2: 1. Dynamic Filtering Engine: Fully interactive filters synchronized with URL query parameters, tightly integrated with GraphQL for lightning-fast queries across pet categories (Dog, Cat, Fish, Bird), discounts, sizes, and price bounds.
ViserPetDetail.overviewP3: 2. Real-Time WebSockets & Social Ecosystem: Live seller-to-buyer chat, instant order status notifications, follower/following network, and community reviews/likes.
ViserPetDetail.overviewP4: 3. Vendor & Admin Dashboards: Dedicated management portals enabling vendors to create/edit listings and track sales, while admins manage platform moderation, user roles, notices, and FAQs.
capabilities: Flexible, high-performance GraphQL schema querying and live mutations
Role-Based Access Control (RBAC: User / Seller / Admin) with secure JWT
Dynamic URL-synchronized multi-parameter filtering and search
WebSocket-driven live chatting and real-time push notification system
Community social ecosystem (Followers, Comments, Likes)
Production deployment via Docker Compose, persistent volumes, and Nginx
ViserPetDetail.videoDescription: Walkthrough of e-commerce checkout, wishlist flows, and dynamic GraphQL filtering.

NestarDetail.role: Full-Stack Engineer & Architect — Real Estate & Cache Platform
NestarDetail.title: NESTAR: South Korea Real Estate & Search Portal
NestarDetail.summary: South Korea real estate listing & property discovery portal for buying, renting, and leasing apartments, villas, and commercial spaces. Engineered with high-performance multi-criteria search (location, room count, price range), real-time agent inquiry channels, and Redis-cached queries.
NestarDetail.problemText: Real estate discovery demands instant multi-faceted filtering across thousands of listings by district, property type, floor level, and price range, paired with seamless agent-buyer communications.
NestarDetail.solutionText: Next.js frontend with server rendering, NestJS backend with optimized SQL/NoSQL schema design, Redis caching layer for hot district queries, and a dedicated property submission dashboard for licensed agents.
NestarDetail.overviewP1: NESTAR is a property discovery portal bridging buyers, tenants, and licensed real estate agencies across South Korea.
NestarDetail.overviewP2: 1. Advanced Multi-Criteria Search: Real-time filtering by district (위치), listing category (매물 유형), room count (방), and price boundaries.
NestarDetail.overviewP3: 2. Direct Agent Channels: Rich property specifications, high-res photo carousels, verified agent profiles, and one-click inquiry routing.
NestarDetail.overviewP4: 3. Platform Security & Moderation: Listing validation pipeline, admin moderation tools, agent licensing verification, and JWT session handling.
capabilities: Multi-faceted real-time property search and listing comparison
Dedicated independent portals for licensed agents and users
Redis caching layer delivering sub-20ms search responses
Fully responsive mobile and desktop user interface
Admin moderation and secure JWT authorization
NestarDetail.videoDescription: Interactive property search, multi-faceted filtering, and real-time agent portal in action.

NikeStoreDetail.role: Full-Stack Engineer & Architect — E-Commerce, REST API & Store Management
NikeStoreDetail.title: Nike Store: Sneaker E-Commerce Platform & Admin Panel
NikeStoreDetail.summary: Modern full-stack e-commerce platform built with React (TypeScript) and Express.js REST API for sneaker enthusiasts. Features dynamic product catalogs, Redux Toolkit cart persistence, role-based JWT authentication, a dedicated store admin management portal, and Linux VPS production deployment.
NikeStoreDetail.problemText: Sneaker e-commerce requires an ultra-responsive user interface, persistent cart state across sessions, and seamless catalog browsing. Simultaneously, store operators need a comprehensive, secure back-office dashboard to manage inventory, track order lifecycles, and monitor platform operations.
NikeStoreDetail.solutionText: Engineered a React (TypeScript) and Material UI client with Redux Toolkit for persistent state synchronization. Implemented a secure Express.js REST API with MongoDB and Mongoose on the backend, fortified with JWT authentication, role-based access control (RBAC), and a dedicated Admin Panel built for product and order fulfillment.
NikeStoreDetail.overviewP1: Nike Store is a full-stack e-commerce platform built to provide a smooth and modern online shopping experience for sneaker enthusiasts. The platform allows users to browse products, view detailed sneaker specifications, select sizes, add items to their cart, and place orders seamlessly.
NikeStoreDetail.overviewP2: 1. Dynamic Shopping Cart & State Management: Powered by Redux Toolkit with Local Storage persistence, ensuring that user cart selections, quantities, and prices remain intact across page reloads and browser sessions.
NikeStoreDetail.overviewP3: 2. Role-Based Authentication & Security: JWT-based authentication protocol separating standard customer accounts from store administrative privileges, guaranteeing safe inventory and order modifications.
NikeStoreDetail.overviewP4: 3. Production VPS Deployment: Deployed on a Linux-based VPS using PM2 for backend process orchestration, Nginx for reverse proxying and SSL/domain routing, complete with DNS and firewall security.
NikeStoreDetail.adminSectionDesc: The Nike Store Admin Panel empowers store managers to perform full CRUD operations on products, manage real-time customer orders, and monitor overall platform activity.
NikeStoreDetail.adminFrontend: Frontend: HTML5, Bootstrap, CSS3, Axios, EJS, jQuery
NikeStoreDetail.adminBackend: Backend: Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, Mongoose, express-session, bcryptjs, JWT, Assert, cookie-parser, Socket.io, Dotenv, Multer
capabilities: Role-based User Authentication (Secure customer and admin role separation)
Store Registration and Profile Management (Store onboarding and dashboard)
Product Add, Edit, and Delete (Full CRUD inventory management)
Order Management System (Order processing and delivery status tracking)
Admin Panel (Centralized console for catalog, orders, and user management)
Dynamic Product Listings (Interactive sneaker filtering and catalog discovery)
REST API Integration with MongoDB (Scalable Express.js and Mongoose architecture)
Dynamic shopping cart using Redux Toolkit (Stateful client shopping experience)
Cart Persistence via Local Storage (Session resilience across reloads)

NoMaklerDetail.role: Frontend & UI/UX Engineer — Real Estate Listings & Comparison Portal
NoMaklerDetail.title: NoMakler: Uzbekistan Real Estate Listing & Discovery Platform
NoMaklerDetail.summary: NoMakler is a modern real estate listing platform focused on property buying, selling, and rental services in Uzbekistan. The platform allows users to browse, search, and compare property listings with detailed information such as price, location, and property metrics through a fast, user-friendly, and responsive web interface.
NoMaklerDetail.problemText: Property seekers required a fast and intuitive way to browse listings, compare prices, sizes, and locations side-by-side, and make confident real estate decisions with direct contact actions.
NoMaklerDetail.solutionText: Engineered enhancements for the property listings and search experience. Focused on improving UI clarity, layout structure, and responsiveness for efficient property comparison. Contributed to overall UX polish, visual consistency, and front-end optimization to deliver a smoother browsing experience.
NoMaklerDetail.overviewP1: NoMakler is a comprehensive real estate listing portal engineered to streamline property discovery for buyers, tenants, and property owners across Uzbekistan.
NoMaklerDetail.overviewP2: 1. Compact & Efficient Listing Layout: Optimized for quick visual scanning, allowing users to assess pricing, location, and key property features at a glance.
NoMaklerDetail.overviewP3: 2. Side-by-Side Comparison & Sorting: Instant multi-criteria comparison of prices, unit sizes, and neighborhood metrics, combined with real-time sorting by newest listings.
NoMaklerDetail.overviewP4: 3. Rich Metadata & Immediate Engagement: Clear floor level, room layout, and metric breakdowns with prominent action-oriented contact channels.
capabilities: Compact listing layout optimized for quick scanning
Side-by-side comparison of prices, sizes, and locations
Sorting by newest listings for up-to-date results
Detailed metadata including floor info and property metrics
Quick contact actions to encourage immediate engagement
Clean, information-rich interface with action-oriented hierarchy
Fully responsive and mobile-optimized design
